description: UAV tile oil palm crown detection dataset prepared from a train-only Roboflow YOLO export

sources.name: Roboflow UAV Oil Palm Crown Export

label_notes: Single-class crown detection. Source metadata mentioned Healthy-BSR-Non-BSR, but the reviewed export contains 100% oil_palm_crown instances and no health-status classes.

split_strategy.constraint: Future UAV exports should include plantation/block/mission IDs so splits can be grouped by mission.
split_strategy.source_limitation: The current Roboflow export has only a train directory and no mission IDs.

notes: Raw images and generated YOLO files are ignored by Git.
The Roboflow export key must not be committed to repository files.
This dataset is for crown localization only; it does not classify health, disease, or yield.
Cloud remains responsible for tile offsets, global coordinate reconstruction, NMS, tree confirmation, and tree_code creation.
